sections.text:
This document outlines the condenser inspection which must be performed every 
 4000 operations hours.

The maintenance procedures aim to guarantee the perfect efficiency of the 
 components involved in the condensing system which should be strictly observed. 
 As a 
 matter of fact a decrease in efficiency or failure of any of these units will 
 adversely effect the condenser performance.

عدد المكثف: 2 
 إجمالي طول الأنابيب : 7.5 م
عدد الأنابيب في كل مكثف : 6800 قطعة

The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Khalil Darwish, 
 tested by eng. Sobhy Tolba Ahmed, accepted by eng. Abdel Fatah 
 Mohamed Shehata and approved by eng. Gomaa Khater Khadr: head sector of Kafr 
 Eldawar power station

A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, shoes, ...etc.
